dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: Hmm... These stitches need to be tighter. Otherwise, those brutes'll just rip everything apart again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you a tailor?

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm just doing some sewing for treasure hunters. That's how I make a living.

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: Their line of work involves lots of activity, which means their clothes wear out fast. Thankfully, they're also willing to pay good Mora to get them fixed. That means I get by, so it's fine by me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're from Inazuma, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: That's right — specifically, from Yashiori Island!

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: Over there... Well, hehe, I just couldn't stay. That's why I came to Nod-Krai. It's a foreign land, but at least it's a safe one for now.

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: But of course, if I need to leave here, that's fine too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: See you! If your clothes need fixing, just come look for me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your skills...

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: Skills? Hehe, I don't have much of any, really. I just do a little work with needle and thread, like I did in my hometown. And practice makes perfect, right?

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: Well... Not that I'm anywhere near close to "perfect." I've failed my master’s expectations and will surely be mocked by my fellow apprentices... but at least these skills have proved useful here. Not a total waste, I suppose...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're working hard.

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm fine. An ordinary gal like me doesn't need much to be happy with her lot in life.

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: Take this place, for example. It's a little cramped, but there's food, shelter, and it's safer than Yashiori Island.

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: Still... thanks for your kind words. They're kinda rare to come by for a wanderer like me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the maddened Inazuma samurai lurking around...

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: ...You must be talking about that maniac who takes a swing or five at anyone he sees. To tell the truth, we're from the same village.

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: He's called Gonpachi. Just like me, he fled Yashiori Island. I guess... you could say he was like a little brother to me.

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: But he strayed onto a path he shouldn't have in order to survive, and crossed people he shouldn't have. In the end, he got his childhood sweetheart, who fled here with him, killed. That's what finally broke him.

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: If you encounter him, please just keep your distance. He's lost his senses... I'm sure he'd cut even me down without a shred of hesitation.

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: Or, well... If you could free him from his suffering, it'll probably be a mercy that poor kid hardly deserves.

dialogues.speaker: Okin
dialogues.text: This fleeting world — a body clad in sorrow. Cherry blossoms fall, untended by tomorrow. Spring departs, never to return... Never to ever return...
